description: Canonical puzzle/solution catalog plus solver retrieval and fragment indexes for Opus Magnum Codex.

identity.canonicalStructuralHash: translation/rotation invariant hash preserving program timing
identity.canonicalMechanismHash: translation/rotation invariant hash with normalized program timing
identity.puzzleFeatureFingerprint: hash of solver-relevant puzzle chemistry, molecule topology, available parts and production constraints

fragmentIndex.purpose: Catalog reusable local functional sub-mechanisms extracted from historical solutions.

evidenceLevels.dynamic-confirmed: Replay directly observed input spawning or output/disposal consumption at the fragment anchor.
evidenceLevels.dynamic-arm-observed: Replay observed arm activity inside the fragment, but the anchor glyph effect is not simulated.
evidenceLevels.structural-only: Fragment is inferred from geometry only or no matching puzzle replay was available.

limitations: Bonding and conversion glyph effects remain unconfirmed while replay glyphSimulation is false.
Evidence is available only when the source puzzle can be resolved for replay.
